article.title: кофе: историческая вариативность рода и кодификация
article.chapter: Género, número y clases nominales — Род, число и типы существительных

claims.summary: Kuznetsova’s corpus study reports masculine/neuter variation from the late seventeenth century through the 1940s and identifies the first unequivocal normative masculine recommendation as the dictionary prepared in 1914 and printed in 1926.
The study directly cites masculine 1812 concordance and neuter 1817 concordance, then reports the later frequency limitation and uncertainty.
The quoted masculine and neuter historical phrases are reproduced from the corpus examples cited by Kuznetsova.
The entry confines itself to the historical study and its stated corpus limits; it does not claim current contemporary normative status.
